_comment: Pinned bot-vs-corpus divergences, consulted by the fixture walkers. Each entry: fixture name -> the bot's measured behavior + a one-line note. This file records drift; it never edits the shared fixtures.

reply extraction: stopReason max_tokens.message: The AI response was cut off at the token limit — try a shorter or simpler request.
reply extraction: stopReason max_tokens.note: Same truncated kind; the bot words the message itself (HttpLlmClient.Truncated) instead of the browser's text.

reply extraction: stopReason refusal sur.message: The AI declined: I cannot help with that.
reply extraction: stopReason refusal sur.note: Same refusal kind; the bot prefixes the provider text with "The AI declined: ".

non-JSON error body falls back to \"HTTP.note: Same fallback seam; the bot's wording is "The LLM endpoint answered HTTP {status}." instead of the browser's bare "HTTP 500".

error message that is ONLY a URL sanitiz.note: Same fallback seam (empty sanitize -> status message); bot wording differs from the browser's bare "HTTP 400".

junk-points-dropped-numeric-strings-coer.note: System.Text.Json binds points strictly: "3" (string) into double throws, so StencilLayoutParser.Parse returns null for the whole layout — no numeric-string coercion, no junk-point dropping.

field-type-coercion-and-drops.note: thickness "3.5" (string) and locked 1 (number) are type mismatches for the typed LayoutLine record — the whole parse returns null instead of coercing/dropping fields.

non-array-lines-become-empty.note: "lines": "junk" cannot bind to IReadOnlyList<LayoutLine> — Parse returns null instead of an empty lines list.

non-object-line-entries-skipped.note: a number/string entry in lines cannot bind to LayoutLine — Parse returns null instead of skipping the entry.

full-featured.note: image.h as the string "600" hits JsonElement.TryGetInt32 on a non-number, which throws InvalidOperationException (uncaught by Parse's JsonException/FormatException filter) — the bot rejects a file the browser normalizes.

version-as-numeric-string-accepted.note: version "1" (string) hits TryGetInt32 on a non-number -> InvalidOperationException — the bot rejects the numeric-string version the browser coerces.

savedAt as a numeric string is coerced.note: ChatDocument.TryParse only reads savedAt when ValueKind is Number — a numeric string reads as 0, not 123.

messages that is not an array — null.note: ChatDocument.TryParse tolerates a non-array messages value and returns a document with zero messages, where the reference treats the whole doc as missing (null).
